# Phase C error corpus -- built-in library rejections.
# ERRORS.md sections 15-16 (jsregexp.c, jsstring.c, jsarray.c, jsobject.c,
# jsnumber.c, jsboolean.c, jsdate.c, jsfunction.c, jsbuiltin.c, json.c, jserror.c),
# rows 320-445. Every snippet MUST error in the C build. No try/catch.
#
# NOT AN ERROR IN THE C BUILD (so deliberately NOT in this file -- they belong in
# the valid-path corpora):
#   row 421 Fp_apply with a negative/absent `length`  -> clamped to 0
#   Fp_apply with a non-array-like (`f.apply(null, 1)`, `f.apply(null, 'ab')`)
#     -> js_getlength coerces, no throw
#   String.prototype.replace with a dangling/out-of-range `$` (`'$'`, `'$9'`,
#     `'$2'` with one group) -> emitted literally, no throw
#   rows 427/428/429 parseInt/parseFloat failures  -> push NaN
#   rows 438/439 JSON.stringify `space` out of range / > 10 chars -> clamped
#   row 343 Ap_join / Ap_toString cycle  -> pushes "" instead of recursing
#   row 322/323/325 stale lastIndex      -> reset + null/false
#   row 332 new RegExp('') / new RegExp() -> substituted with "(?:)"
#   trailing garbage after a complete JSON value (`JSON.parse('1 2')`) -> ignored;
#     json.c stops after the first value and never checks for EOF
